children: CHICAGO (dpa-AFX) - Wednesday, China Southern Airlines Company Limited (1055.HK) announced that its subsidiary, Xiamen Airlines, agreed to purchase 50 B737-8 aircraft from Boeing Co. (BA) for approximately $7.4 billion in cash.

The purchase, which will be delivered in stages from 2031 to 2034, will be funded partly by internal resources of the Group and partly through loans or other financing arrangements by banks or other institutions.

The agreement is in line with the company's long-term fleet planning. Also, it will help diversify the Group's aircraft portfolio, strengthen the core competitiveness, and enhance operational flexibility.
The company's stock closed trading at HK$2.655, down 1.12 percent on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
